news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage with Buy Rating, C$1.54 Price Target
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter (TSXV:PINK; OTCQX:PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13. The target is based on a 10-year DCF assuming sharp 2026 uptake of Claire OCT followed by steady growth toward 9%+ lumpectomy penetration by 2035.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a New Healthcare Top Pick
news.summary: Paradigm Capital named Perimeter a new Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and C$0.95 price target, versus a C$0.275 close on July 3. The analyst cited the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire as positioning the company to accelerate commercial rollout and draw more market interest.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Perimeter is pursuing Medicare reimbursement for Claire via the New Technology APC (and TCET) pathway; a favorable CMS decision would be a major catalyst for hospital adoption economics, but no official CMS decision date has been confirmed.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet announced a specific date for its Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30) earnings release and conference call as of Aug 7, 2026; third-party estimate trackers show unconfirmed placeholder dates ranging from late Aug to Sep 1, 2026.

catalysts.label: Continued commercial rollout of Claire OCT+AI
catalysts.detail: Following March 2026 FDA PMA approval, Perimeter is scaling commercial placements of Claire (successor to the S-Series) across existing hospital relationships (e.g., Intermountain Health, Medical City Dallas) and pursuing new health-system agreements; incremental placement/adoption announcements are a recurring near-term catalyst.

pulse: Perimeter continues commercializing its FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI device for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, with analyst attention building: Paradigm Capital (Top Pick, C$0.95 target) and Brookline Capital Markets (Buy, C$1.54 target) both initiated bullish coverage in the first half of July 2026. No major company-specific news has emerged since mid-July, leaving the CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision and the still-undated Q2 2026 earnings release as the key near-term catalysts to watch.
